subject: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@stellarretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue

Tom / Stellar procurement team — attaching the final MAP and a one-page decision matrix to make the go/no-go explicit and to lock down signer windows. High level:

- Target start date: 2027-01-10 (customer-facing rollout window)
- Legal signoff complete => DocuSign envelope prepared; procurement signature required within a 3-business-day window to meet the target start date
- Contingency: if signatures slip beyond 2026-11-22 we shift to the secondary start date 2027-01-24 (gives engineering a two-week buffer)

Action items from our side: we will route the envelope to the three signers you identified (Tom R., Head of IT, Head of Procurement). Please confirm the preferred 3-day window for signatures so we can schedule the envelope TTL and reserved capacity ramp with Ops.

Attachments: MAP_final_v3.pdf (map with milestones), Signature_Timing_Matrix.xlsx (signer windows and fallback options).

Happy to jump on a 15-minute call this afternoon if you want to walk the matrix.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[attachment: MAP_final_v3.pdf (application/pdf)]
[attachment: Signature_Timing_Matrix.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarretail.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@stellarretail.com>, Aditi Shah <aditi@starlift.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue

Rafael — thanks for the clear matrix. Two quick items from our side: 

1) Procurement can commit to a signer window of Nov 16–18 (we prefer earlier in that window). That should meet your primary start date.
2) Legal flagged a single contract redline around data residency for the pilot environment. Aditi (our PM) is on copy — she will confirm whether we can accept the residency clause as-is for the pilot or if Legal needs a short amendment.

If Legal needs an amendment, can you confirm how that impacts the canary plan and whether we can still hit Jan 10 with a small SLA caveat?

Cheers,
Tom
Tom Reynolds
VP, Global Procurement
Stellar Retail

On 2026-11-08 09:12, Rafael Mendes wrote:
> Tom / Stellar procurement team — attaching the final MAP and a one-page decision matrix...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue

Folks — looping internal owners:

- Legal (Laura) — please confirm whether a narrow data-residency amendment would force a new security review or if we can treat it as a pilot-scoped exception with a written caveat. If it requires a security re-eval, we need to call out the extra two-week review in the decision matrix.
- Ops (Connor) — can you provision a temporary dedicated pool (2 A100 equivalents) for the canary if signatures land in the Nov 16–18 window? Also note we should set a hold on capacity for the fallback window if Tom pushes to Nov 23+.
- Sales (Rafael) — I'll prepare a short delta doc that summarizes the legal ask so Tom can route to his counsel quickly.

I updated the Signature_Timing_Matrix: the primary envelope TTL is 72 hours; fallback TTLs are listed for staggered signer availability. I attached the delta summary for clarity.

Marissa Cole
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: DataResidency_Delta.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@stellarretail.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue

Marissa / Rafael / Tom — quick update from Legal and Security:

- The proposed data-residency language for the pilot is acceptable as a scoped exception provided Stellar signs the pilot addendum (one para) and acknowledges the post-pilot remediation plan. That addendum is procedural — Legal does NOT require a full security re-eval.
- We will prepare the pilot addendum and target to have it cleared by 2026-11-15 so it can be attached to the DocuSign envelope.

Rafael — once you confirm Procurement's firm signer window we should:
1) Publish the DocuSign envelope with the pilot addendum attached;
2) Set envelope TTL to 72 hours with explicit signer order (Procurement, Head of IT, Tom);
3) Signal Ops to reserve the canary pool for the week starting Jan 3 (to allow integration testing ahead of Jan 10).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T16:04:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Final go/no-go decision matrix & signer queue

Confirmed — I will reserve the 2 A100-equivalent slots for the Jan 3 canary week and hold a soft reservation for the fallback window. If the envelope ships Nov 16–18 I will schedule the onboarding runbook and a 2-hour verification slot on Jan 6.

Also calling out a small note: if the signatures slip into late November (post 11/22) we will need to shift the maritime of the integration window by two weeks to maintain risk tolerances. I'll update the Ops runbook and share the link when done.

Connor O'Brien
Head of Operations, Redwood Inference
